tagline: Verify what you build. Prove what you deploy.
mission: Verifiable trust infrastructure for onchain applications: release evidence, SHA-256 canonical hashing, Ed25519 attestations, deployment verification, RPC state inspection, expected-vs-observed drift detection, and interactive 3D Trust Graph.

theme_strategy.theme_description: Dark, bold, sophisticated, futuristic, precise, and premium. Tactical telemetry aesthetic inspired by Palantir Foundry, high-assurance aerospace telemetry, and cryptographically verifiable systems. Strictly avoids AI slop, purple gradients, childish emojis, and fake console gimmicks.

hierarchy.h1_hero: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-semibold tracking-tight text-slate-100
hierarchy.eyebrow_label: text-xs font-mono font-medium tracking-[0.18em] uppercase text-slate-400
hierarchy.hash_code: text-xs font-mono text-emerald-400/95 tracking-wider bg-emerald-950/30 px-2 py-0.5 rounded border border-emerald-500/20

rules: No full-bleed purple or rainbow AI gradients.
Strict dark mode baseline with warm graphite depth.
Emerald (#10B981) reserved strictly for verified / signed / healthy states.
Amber (#F59E0B) for pending reviews, low telemetry drift, or warnings.
Red (#EF4444) strictly for critical production drift, compromised authority, or signature mismatches.
Violet (#8B5CF6) and Electric Blue (#0EA5E9) for RPC nodes, chains, and infrastructure metadata.

visual_enhancers.grid_pattern: Tactical subtle 24px grid overlay (rgba(255,255,255,0.03)) to ground the technical precision.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px fine solid strokes (border-white/10 or border-emerald-500/20) with 6px-8px subtle border radii.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Deep crisp ambient shadows: shadow-[0_4px_24px_rgba(0,0,0,0.6)] with 1px inner highlight border.
visual_enhancers.badges: Structured tactical pills with a pulsing indicator dot, font-mono label, and high-contrast status text.

killer_demo_specification.behavior: When clicked: 1) Sets system state to DRIFT_CRITICAL. 2) Injects banner across the top: 'CRITICAL PRODUCTION DRIFT — Production no longer matches the approved state. Bytecode hash mismatch detected on Ethereum Mainnet contract 0x7a25...'. 3) Injects linked incident INC-8924 into Incident Center. 4) Updates the 3D Trust Graph by coloring the deployment node blazing red and showing an animated pulsing red shockwave link. 5) Shows audit differential: Expected SHA256 vs Observed SHA256 bytecode hash.

trust_graph_specification.mode: Dual-mode: 3D Canvas with 2D Fallback SVG / HTML node graph toggle.
trust_graph_specification.r3f_package_note: If @react-three/fiber is installed, render the interactive 3D orb/node graph with Canvas, OrbitControls, and floating nodes for: Commit/Repo -> Release Artifact -> Ed25519 Attestation -> Ethereum/Solana RPC -> Live Verified Deployment. If unavailable or disabled by user toggle, gracefully fallback to the high-tech 2D interactive topological SVG graph.

founder_command_center.focus: Transparent Trust Score (98.4% -> 74.2% on drift), High-level compliance health, Risk exposure summary, Executive sign-off logs, Time-to-attestation KPI.
widgets: Composite Trust Index with 5 verifiable vector gauges

developer_command_center.focus: Canonical SHA-256 calculator & evidence builder, Raw RPC bytecode inspector, Diff visualizer (Expected vs Observed), CLI push token generator, Incident investigation terminal with AI Assistant.

instructions_to_main_agent: Never introduce any Emergent branding in product UI.

Do not use generic SaaS templates with centered text and pastel purple gradients. Adhere strictly to the tactical Palantir-inspired dark design system with graphite, neon emerald, warning amber, and alert red.

Every testable action MUST have the required data-testid attributes: 'simulate-drift-btn', 'reset-drift-btn', 'critical-drift-banner', 'trust-score-metric', 'nav-founder-cockpit', 'nav-developer-ops', 'nav-trust-graph', 'nav-releases', 'nav-deployments', 'nav-incidents', 'nav-ai-investigator', 'nav-integrations'.
All navigation bars must have solid or heavy crystal glass backgrounds (bg-[#0B0E14]/90 backdrop-blur-md) with 1px border-b border-white/10. Never use pure transparent navigation.
Include both the interactive 3D Trust Graph and the instant 2D Fallback view switch so the user can inspect cryptographic lineage smoothly.
Provide the killer demo banner with high priority visual weight whenever drift is simulated.
Ensure hash displays feature easy one-click copy with Sonner toast feedback ('SHA-256 Copied to clipboard').
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and tactical borders.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) on sticky headers and flyouts.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g. transition: all). Add transitions to specific interactive properties.
You MUST NOT center align the app container. Do not add .App { text-align: center; }.
Never use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 for icons. Use lucide-react tactical icons exclusively.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, and entrance animations.
Containers with borders must have internal padding (p-6 or p-8) to prevent text collision.
